description: The shared headless-agent runner: the script headless-agent (one source for every package that runs a coder) and the reference profiles. A package keeps its own profiles as tokens and invokes the script from its own command lane; this net runs nothing by itself.

p-headless-agent-profiles.label: Reference profiles (claude-code-read-only, codex-read-only); a package copies the ones it needs into its own store
